timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.77 today, down 26 cents from a month ago and up $1.08 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.62. Fill up and smile a little.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Missouri's archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13. Time to make that last sit count.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, and runs through Nov. 24. Time to find the orange hat.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season reopens Wednesday, Nov. 25, and runs through Jan. 15. Bowhunters get a second round.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season runs Friday, Nov. 27, through Nov. 29. A great weekend to take the kids.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11. Take a minute to thank a veteran.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26, three weeks away. Time to start the pie plan.

timely.label: Black Friday
timely.line: Black Friday is Friday, Nov. 27, 22 days out. Start stretching those shopping legs.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The animated The Cat in the Hat, with Bill Hader as the Cat, opens in theaters Friday, Nov. 6. Bring the kids, leave the mess.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: The Beach Boys' 'Kokomo' hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1988. Now try not to hum it.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Hall & Oates began two weeks at No. 1 with 'Private Eyes' in 1981. Hands clap, heads nod.

timely.label: Fun Fact
timely.line: The Pillsbury Dough Boy first appeared in TV commercials in 1965. Still giggling after all these years.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: The IRS lets you stash up to $3,400 in a health FSA, but only $680 can roll over, so use the rest before Dec. 31. Spend it or lose it.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: eBay's CEO estimates a household has $4,000 worth of stuff to sell online, but fees can swallow a small sale and an IRS rule catches many sellers off guard. Check the garage first.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Black Friday 2026 is starting much earlier than in previous years. Your wallet should start stretching now.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A serving of beef jerky has 10 to 15 grams of protein, but sodium can reach 500 milligrams or more, dietitians say. Read the label before the second bag.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster who spent years at laundromats says to use the extended spin cycle to wring out water, then shake each wet item to unclump it before it goes in the dryer. Free tip, no quarters needed.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom spent about $300 on her first Costco trip hoping it would last three weeks, and asked how seasoned shoppers actually save. Costco regulars, speak up.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes' cheeseburger soup packs ground beef, bacon, potatoes and cheddar into a creamy one-pot family dinner. Dinner and cleanup in one pot.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's braised cabbage wedges simmer in a tomato and wine sauce until tender and taste like stuffed cabbage without the meat. Meatless Monday just got easy.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: The Kitchn's pear crisp tucks tender pear slices under a buttery brown sugar oat topping, with less peeling than apples. Apples can take a night off.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Reddit meal prepper bought a 10-pound tube of 80/20 ground beef at $3.99 a pound and asked what to make. Hello, freezer meals.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: First-timer Joe Bidinot landed a 57-inch muskie on Georgian Bay, Ontario, on the evening of Oct. 27. Beginner's luck, big time.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Max Wynn's bow blew up as he went to arrow his target buck, so he bought a starter setup, went back out for the same deer the next day and still got it. Persistence beats equipment failure.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit parent says their toddler's favorite old shows, like Little Bear and Dragon Tales, have almost no toys, party napkins or clothes in stores. Time to check Etsy.
